title: Sewer, Trash and Flat Utility Fee Tariff — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
This tariff sheet lists the sewer, trash collection and flat utility fee figures of every Utility Pass-Through Service schedule. All amounts are USD per billing period unless stated otherwise.

## Tariff table

| Service schedule | Flat utility fee (water, sewer and trash) | Sewer flat fee | Sewer base charge | Sewer rate (USD per kgal of water) | Sewer monthly cap (kgal) | Trash flat fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | 74.50 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water Schedule | not applicable | 38.50 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 21.75 |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | 12.40 | 6.94 | 8.00 | 19.40 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | 14.75 | 7.88 | 7.00 | 23.10 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | 13.90 | 8.12 | 7.00 | 24.65 |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | 11.60 | 6.35 | 9.00 | 18.90 |

## Column definitions

- **Flat utility fee**: the single flat monthly charge covering water, sewer and trash on the flat-rate schedule; it does not apply on submetered schedules.
- **Sewer flat fee**: the flat monthly sewer charge, used only where sewer is billed as a flat fee.
- **Sewer base charge**: the fixed monthly sewer charge billed alongside metered sewer, used only where sewer is metered on water.
- **Sewer rate**: the sewer rate on water consumption up to the cap, USD per thousand gallons, used only where sewer is metered on water.
- **Sewer monthly cap**: the largest water consumption, in thousand gallons, on which sewer is charged in one billing period, used only where sewer is metered on water.
- **Trash flat fee**: the flat monthly trash collection charge; it does not apply where trash is included in the flat utility fee.

## Reading the table

**Which sewer figures belong together?** A schedule uses either the sewer flat fee (Submetered Water Schedule) or the pair of sewer base charge and sewer rate with its cap (the four schedules with metered sewer) — never both. On the flat-rate schedule sewer has no figure of its own because it sits inside the 74.50 flat utility fee.

**Illustration of the cap (hypothetical consumption):** on the Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule the cap is 7.00 kgal, so a site using 9.20 kgal of water in a period is charged sewer on 7.00 kgal, while a site using 5.10 kgal is charged sewer on all 5.10 kgal.
